text: I checked the live list (563 PropLine lines, 500 that Vigilant also prices). Vigilant says 470 of the 500 are 0% or worse (average -0.2%); PropLine's own average on the same lines is +3.3%. Stale prices are NOT the reason: Novig's price now equals PropLine's price on 411 of 500 (82%), and PropLine's reads are a median 10 min old. The gap is the fair odds: on these lines PropLine's fair chance averages 36.1% vs Vigilant's 31.7%. PropLine takes ONE book's no-vig number (Pinnacle, Polymarket or Kalshi) and calls any gap +EV; Vigilant blends the sharp books with the worst-case devig and cuts props for the known bias. Picking the biggest gaps out of hundreds also picks the noisiest ones. On the evidence I trust Vigilant: PropLine-flagged prop Overs lost money on 6,400 graded bets. So treat PropLine's list as leads, and bet the ones where Vigilant also shows +EV (the Bet button on those is the Vigilant-priced slip). I'll add a filter 'Vigilant agrees (+EV)' on that screen so only those show.
